projectDescription: A hosted runner that automatically turns a labelled GitHub Issue into a tested, independently reviewed, and merged pull request — with no setup beyond installing a GitHub App.
keyFeatures: Zero-setup delivery: label a GitHub Issue ai-ready to dispatch work — no extra tooling required
Independent review loop: a separate AI session reviews the generated pull request and repairs findings before merge
Automatic merge: clean-reviewed commits are merged to your base branch without human intervention
Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): optionally route model traffic through your own provider account and API key
Release automation: type a version to run a deterministic release state machine with full gate evidence
Priority dispatch: p0 label and task-type labels (ai-ops-only, ai-content-only, ai-release) for flexible workflows
Steering in flight: comment on a running Issue to redirect work without cancelling
Full audit trail: all state is visible directly in GitHub via ai-* labels, comments, and pull requests
Tenant isolation: each tenant runs in a separate OS-level environment
Usage transparency: per-delivery token counts, cache hit rates, and quota status on the status page
publicApiSurface: ai-ready label — dispatches an Issue to Orbi for development
ai-in-progress label — set by Orbi when a delivery session is running
ai-pr-opened label — set by Orbi when the pull request is open and awaiting review
ai-fix-needed label — set by Orbi when the review found issues requiring repair
ai-merged label — set by Orbi on successful merge
ai-blocked label — set by Orbi when automatic recovery is not safe; human decision required
ai-awaiting-merge label — pull request is ready and waiting for a maintainer to approve
ai-release label — paired with ai-ready to trigger the release state machine
ai-ops-only label — paired with ai-ready to run the ops/research playbook
ai-content-only label — paired with ai-ready to run the content playbook
ai-human-review label — set by humans to record manual review confirmation
p0 label — marks an Issue for priority pickup ahead of others
orbi.build/api/ — the Orbi Cloud status page and primary UI
Stripe billing portal — subscription management, invoices, cancellation
Cut a release form — creates a Release Issue with ai-ready + ai-release labels
Model configuration page — BYOK provider/key/model setup
Connect repository page — repository and base branch selection
